import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='skyblue')
plt.title('Total Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
